Rockaway Botanica was created to make plant collecting feel intentional, elevated, and accessible. I believe urban greening is not just about selling plants — it's about helping people reconnect with nature in a way that feels personal and sustainable. As someone born in Trinidad and now building my plant business in New York, plants have always represented culture, care, and community to me. NYC Plant Market aligns beautifully with my mission: to transform everyday spaces into living sanctuaries and to connect with fellow plant lovers across the city.

vendors.bio: I want to be part of NY Plant Market because it brings together a passionate community of plant lovers, collectors, and small businesses in a way that truly celebrates creativity and connection. As the owner of Wild Sage Ranch, I curate unique houseplants and create custom terrariums that act as living art pieces, and I love sharing that vision with people who appreciate both the aesthetic and wellness benefits of plants. I’m especially drawn to the energy and diversity the market attracts, as it’s not just about selling but about building relationships, connecting with other vendors, and creating memorable experiences for customers. I regularly travel for plant events, so opportunities like this mean a lot to me, and I see NY Plant Market as the perfect space to grow my brand while contributing something fresh and inspiring to the community.
